name_en: Shima somen — somen noodles served in the broth of simmered sea bream
summary_ja: 出羽島でとれるれんこ鯛を甘辛く煮付け、その煮汁をめんつゆ代わりにそうめんを食べる牟岐町の一品。祭りや婚礼、宴会に欠かせない料理とされ、煮汁まで無駄にしない工夫から生まれたという。
summary_en: Renko sea bream caught off Deshima island is simmered sweet and salty, and the leftover broth is used in place of noodle dipping sauce for somen, in this dish from Mugi Town. Said to be indispensable at festivals, weddings, and banquets, born of a wish not to waste even the simmering liquid.
source_title: 島そうめん 徳島県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
